geometryAndStyle.borderNormalization: Contiguous same-color cell borders form one row region; independent bottom pseudo and outer clipping are preserved.

limitations: Font-unit contours are exact; the recorded PDF matrix has serializer rounding.
Unicode aliases are checked against the source cmap; this does not prove editable text content.
PDF glyph paths do not establish native PNG raster edges or full component fidelity.

baselines.pdfXSerialization: five decimal half-up; exact x bound by nodes and source-identical whole native SVG

limitations: The font resource is served from the hash-verified local font container, not a remote download.
Browser SVG raster is diagnostic; native PNG remains the production screenshot.
